Package io.github.protasm.jvmud.engine.support

package io.github.protasm.jvmud.engine.support
Small shared helpers used by engine model packages.

Classes here support the public engine model without defining new MUD concepts. They should stay boring, dependency-light, and subordinate to the concrete packages such as world, identity, time, mudlib, and output.
